verdict.rationale: Better Stack's incident-management page says a todo list can be posted automatically when an incident is triggered, and that incidents can be routed to the right responder. That is a thin, runbook-like checklist with automatic responder assignment. There is no evidence of runbook objects with executable steps. The AI SRE investigates incidents, but it is invoked by tagging and does not act automatically without approval. missing for 10: documented runbooks attachable to incidents, automated step execution, automatic incident channel creation, automated diagnostics as runbook steps, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, runbooks attach to incidents and their steps can trigger automatically — creating channels, assigning tasks, running diagnostics

citations.quote: Post a todo list when a new incident is triggered. Route the incident to the right responder.
